outcome: Rates of obesity, mental health conditions, substance use disorder, asthma, pregestational and gestational diabetes
cohort: Deliveries to patients aged 11-54 years from the 2000-2018 National Inpatient Sample
finding: While deliveries among patients aged 11-19 years have decreased, both comorbidity and risk for adverse outcomes, including severe maternal morbidity, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and postpartum hemorrhage, have increased among this age group.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery among patients aged 11-19 years increased significantly from 2000 to 2018.
